extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) species labels had case and space variants (e.g., 'adelie' vs 'Adelie'), which were normalized; (2) one row had an impossible flipper length of -187 mm (below the min of 170), so it was excluded; (3) two exact duplicate rows were found and removed. The 'body_mass_g' column had comma-separated numbers, which were successfully converted to numeric. After these fixes, the average flipper length by species is: Adelie: 187.94 mm, Chinstrap: 197.33 mm, Gentoo: 217.07 mm.
